sources.entry: Gitee - Gitee, macOS status bar application for Github.

summary.one_liner: Gitee is a macOS status bar app that shows GitHub stars, followers, notifications, trends and repository statistics.
summary.what_it_does: Gitee sits in the macOS status bar and periodically pulls data from GitHub. It shows total stars, followers and notification counts on the status bar. A main window offers basic profile information such as avatar and contributions, plus a pie chart of stargazers across your repositories with an adjustable minimum threshold. A bar/line chart, drawn in WKWebView with ECharts, tracks follower or stargazer trends by a selectable time unit. It also lists GitHub trending repositories and shows notifications, which can be marked as read or unsubscribed from; desktop reminders fire for each unread notification, checked every 10 minutes by default.
use_cases: track github star count over time
monitor github notifications from the menu bar
notable: Lives in the macOS status bar with a toolbar for refresh, settings and quit
Pie chart of stargazers per repository with adjustable minimum count
Trend charts for followers or stargazers with selectable time unit
Desktop notifications for unread GitHub notifications, with mark-as-read and unsubscribe
caveats: README has no download or build instructions; the Download section is empty
